tw: After a while, Kron's laughter makes the crocodile smile a mile wide.
twc: 过了一会儿，Kron 的笑声让鳄鱼笑得嘴咧了一英里宽。
hint: 笑一会儿，鳄鱼嘴就合不上了。

tw: Kron and a tern turn the burnt pancake over onto a clover-eating cow.
twc: Kron 和一只燕鸥把烤焦的煎饼翻过来，翻到了吃草的牛身上。

tw: Quick Kron tries to trick a chick into doing his sticky dishes.
twc: 机灵的 Kron 想骗小鸡替他洗黏糊糊的碗。
hint: 骗小鸡洗碗，真是好算盘。

tw: Kron and six foxes fix their eyes on one fish in a mixing bowl.
twc: Kron 和六只狐狸把目光都集中在搅拌碗里的一条鱼上。

tw: Bold Kron and an old owl hold out cold ice pops to a shouting trout.
twc: 勇敢的 Kron 和老猫头鹰把冰棍递给一条大叫的鳟鱼。
hint: 递出冰棍，鳟鱼只挑他的。

tw: Under the name Thunder, masked Kron tames a mane-shaking lion in the rain.
twc: Kron 用“雷霆”这个名字戴上面具，雨中驯服了甩鬃狮子。

tw: Kron fell down a dry well, and his shell bell fell as well.
twc: Kron 掉进了一口枯井，他的贝壳铃铛也掉了下来。
hint: 自己掉下去，铃铛也跟着。

tw: In his spare time, Kron paints a hare's portrait on a square dime.
twc: 空闲时，Kron 在一枚方形硬币上给野兔画肖像。

tw: To a certain degree, Kron is certain the green tree is a curtain.
twc: 在某种程度上，Kron 确信那棵绿树是一幅窗帘。

tw: Kron can't get used to his pet goose using his new boots as pools.
twc: Kron 一直不习惯，他的宠物鹅把他的新靴子当泳池。

tw: Kron plays chess with a lifeless scarecrow and still loses five times.
twc: Kron 跟一个毫无生气的稻草人下棋，还输了五盘。
hint: 对手一动不动，照样赢他。

tw: The greenhouse effect makes a green queen mouse fan Kron with a perfect leaf.
twc: 温室效应热得绿色鼠女王拿一片完美的叶子给 Kron 扇风。

tw: Kron counts mountains of brown buttons on a fountain in town.
twc: Kron 在镇上的喷泉边数一座座棕色纽扣堆成的山。

tw: Kron has to act as a bat, so he hangs upside down in a black hat.
twc: Kron 要扮演一只蝙蝠，只好戴着黑帽子倒挂着。

tw: Kron and six kittens sit around a round brown pound cake.
twc: Kron 和六只小猫围坐在一个圆圆的棕色磅蛋糕旁。

tw: Kron and his crow have no time to do homework, so they fly kites.
twc: Kron 和他的乌鸦没空做作业，于是去放风筝了。
hint: 没空写作业，却有空放风筝。

tw: Chef Kron's calls fall on deaf ears, as all the deer wear earmuffs.
twc: 大厨 Kron 喊开饭没人理，因为所有鹿都戴着耳罩。

tw: Kron and a bear stare at a fat pear sitting on a chair.
twc: Kron 和一头熊盯着一个坐在椅子上的胖梨。
hint: 一个梨，坐出了大人物气场。

tw: Kron cries out in surprise as a surfer's prize pie flies into his eyes.
twc: 冲浪手的奖品馅饼飞到 Kron 眼前，他惊讶地大叫。

tw: For now, four brown cows snore on Kron's couch, and he sleeps on the floor.
twc: 暂时让四头棕色奶牛在 Kron 的沙发上打呼，他睡地板。
